kpis.name: Board Gender Diversity Ratio
kpis.description: Percentage of board seats held by women, measured at the end of each reporting period. Primary metric tracked by the FTSE Women Leaders Review and its Hampton-Alexander predecessor (40% by 2025) and under the UK Corporate Governance Code.
kpis.target: >= 40% female representation (FTSE 350 target); >= 33% minimum per gender (EU CSRD-aligned)
kpis.formula: (Number of women on board / Total board size) x 100
kpis.source: Company annual report, board register, Companies House filings

kpis.name: Board Ethnic Diversity Ratio
kpis.description: Percentage of board seats held by directors from ethnic minorities, benchmarked against Parker Review expectations for the company's index positioning.
kpis.target: At least one director of colour (Parker minimum); aspirational >= 15-20% of board
kpis.formula: (Number of ethnic minority directors / Total board size) x 100
kpis.source: Annual report, self-identified ethnicity data, Parker Review reports

kpis.name: Intersectionality Representation Score
kpis.description: Composite score reflecting representation across overlapping identities (gender x ethnicity x age band), penalising single-dimension achievement.
kpis.formula: Weighted average of representation across identity intersections, adjusted for population benchmark
kpis.source: Self-identified diversity data, validated against two sources

kpis.name: Candidate Pipeline Diversity Ratio
kpis.description: Diversity (gender and ethnicity) of the board-ready candidate pipeline maintained by the nomination committee and search partners.
kpis.target: >= 50% diverse (gender or ethnicity) across the active pipeline
kpis.formula: (Diverse candidates in pipeline / Total candidates in pipeline) x 100
kpis.source: Search firm reports, nomination committee pipeline tracker

kpis.name: Board Age Diversity
kpis.description: Age range and average age of directors, indicating generational diversity and succession risk.
kpis.target: Age range >= 25 years; mean within peer median +/- 3 years
kpis.formula: Mean age and (max age - min age) across sitting directors
kpis.source: Board register, annual report, Companies House

kpis.name: Board Tenure Diversity
kpis.description: Tenure distribution across directors, including average tenure, range, and the proportion serving beyond the 9-year independence presumption.
kpis.target: Average tenure 4-7 years; <= 25% of directors > 9 years
kpis.formula: Mean tenure, tenure range, and (directors > 9 years / total directors) x 100
kpis.source: Board register, appointment dates, annual report

kpis.name: Board Independence Ratio
kpis.description: Proportion of directors assessed as independent under the applicable corporate governance code, a core measure of board balance.
kpis.target: >= 50% independent (excluding the chair); at least half the board excluding the chair (UK Code)
kpis.formula: (Independent directors / Total directors) x 100
kpis.source: Annual report independence statements, board register

kpis.name: Skills Matrix Coverage Score
kpis.description: Coverage of the agreed board skills/competency matrix, indicating gaps relative to the strategy.
kpis.formula: Weighted coverage of required competencies, penalising uncovered critical skills
kpis.source: Board skills matrix, evaluation outputs

kpis.name: Board Refresh Rate
kpis.description: Rate of board turnover (appointments and retirements) over a rolling period, indicating refresh momentum for building diversity.
kpis.target: 10-20% annual turnover over a rolling 3-year window
kpis.formula: (Appointments + retirements over period / Average board size) x 100
kpis.source: Board register, annual report

kpis.name: Director Retention Rate
kpis.description: Proportion of directors retained over the period, with differential attrition analysis for diverse directors.
kpis.target: >= 85% retention; no significant gap between diverse and overall retention
kpis.formula: (Directors retained / Directors at start of period) x 100, segmented by diversity dimension
kpis.source: Board register, exit records

kpis.name: Diversity Policy Adoption Status
kpis.description: Status of formal adoption of the board diversity policy by resolution, tracked to the AGM cycle.
kpis.target: Adopted by board resolution and disclosed in the annual report
kpis.formula: Categorical: Not started / Drafted / Approved / Adopted / Disclosed
kpis.source: Board minutes, resolution, annual report

kpis.name: Regulatory Compliance Score
kpis.description: Composite score of compliance with applicable diversity governance obligations (UK Code, Parker, FTSE Women Leaders, CSRD/ESRS, SEC).
kpis.formula: Weighted sum of obligation statuses (compliant / explained / breach)
kpis.source: Compliance checklist, legal review, annual report

kpis.name: Reporting Disclosure Completeness Score
kpis.description: Completeness of mandatory and voluntary diversity disclosures against the applicable reporting framework.
kpis.formula: (Required disclosure elements present / Total required elements) x 100
kpis.source: Annual report, ESG report, disclosure framework

kpis.name: Board Evaluation Completion Rate
kpis.description: Whether the annual internal and triennial external board evaluations are completed on schedule to code requirements.
kpis.target: 100% completed within cycle (internal annual; external every 3 years for FTSE 350)
kpis.formula: (Completed evaluations / Required evaluations) x 100
kpis.source: Evaluation schedule, board minutes

kpis.name: Board Effectiveness Index
kpis.description: Composite index of board effectiveness dimensions (dynamics, information quality, committee function, contribution) from evaluation and self-assessment.
kpis.formula: Weighted average of effectiveness dimension scores
kpis.source: Board evaluation, self-assessment questionnaire

kpis.name: Succession Plan Coverage
kpis.description: Proportion of board and key committee roles with a documented, current succession plan.
kpis.target: 100% of roles with current succession plans
kpis.formula: (Roles with current succession plan / Total roles) x 100
kpis.source: Succession planning framework, nomination committee records

kpis.name: Glass Cliff Risk Index
kpis.description: Composite indicator of glass cliff exposure, combining crisis-conditioned appointments, board size trend, and turnover around diverse appointments.
kpis.formula: Weighted composite of crisis-appointment flag, board size trend, and turnover around diverse appointments
kpis.source: Appointment context review, board register, performance signals

kpis.name: Nomination Committee Refresh Rate
kpis.description: Turnover and renewal within the nomination committee itself, indicating its own diversity and dynamism.
kpis.target: Periodic renewal avoiding stagnation; committee composition reviewed annually
kpis.formula: (New nomination committee members over period / Total members) x 100
kpis.source: Committee records, annual report

kpis.name: Mentorship Programme Participation Rate
kpis.description: Proportion of eligible participants actively engaged in the board mentorship programme.
kpis.formula: (Active participants / Eligible participants) x 100
kpis.source: Programme tracker, mentor/mentee records

kpis.name: DEI Maturity Score
kpis.description: Position and progression on the DEI maturity model (Compliance to Representation to Inclusion to Belonging).
kpis.target: Stage progression: reach Inclusion (stage 3) within the engagement horizon
kpis.formula: Maturity stage assigned from assessment evidence (1=Compliance, 2=Representation, 3=Inclusion, 4=Belonging)
kpis.source: Maturity assessment, evaluation, interviews

kpis.name: Diversity Target Progress
kpis.description: Actual diversity outcome measured against the agreed target by year, tracking trajectory and gap closure.
kpis.target: On-track or ahead to meet each target by its due date
kpis.formula: (Actual value / Target value) x 100, plotted by target year
kpis.source: Diversity metrics baseline, target tracker

kpis.name: Stakeholder Engagement Frequency
kpis.description: Frequency and coverage of engagement with key stakeholders (board, committee, investors, regulators) on diversity matters.
kpis.target: At least quarterly board/committee touchpoints; investor engagement per stewardship plan
kpis.formula: Count of documented engagement events per stakeholder group per period
kpis.source: Engagement log, communication plan
